item.title: Rep. Analilia Mejia launches super PAC to support progressive primary victories
item.description: After an upset primary win against better-funded rivals, Rep. Analilia Mejia (D-N.J.) is starting a super PAC to back similar progressive candidates.

item.title: US jobs market shows signs of recovery
item.description: The labor market appears much stronger than earlier in the summer. Friday's jobs report has shifted the outlook, reducing concerns about a slowdown.

item.title: Trump team drafts post-war Middle East strategy
item.description: The administration is developing a plan to contain Iran and promote normalization of relations between regional countries after the conflict.

item.title: High costs loom over summer's end
item.description: Rising gasoline and food prices are making the final holiday weekend more expensive for consumers, adding financial strain.
